rules.body: Apply when a reusable source serves distinct visits and attempts, emits synchronously during startup, and decodes immediately or later. README.md: "Selecting a file creates a visit. Retry replaces the physical attempt without\nopening another visit. Selecting the same file object again opens a new visit.\nThe source is shared by attempts and visits for that file." File identity alone must not identify the active visit.

Register the panel listener before the startup operation that can emit cached packets. TASK: "A transfer with a warm progress source shows no initial progress until a later\npacket arrives. Restore the initial progress update without changing the public\ntransfer, retry, navigation, cleanup, audit, or queue-record behavior." The original ordering in src/Workflow.java is "env.call(\"start\",file.token);subscription=((Number)env.call(\"listen\",file.token,callback)).intValue();" Scope this ordering repair to the panel consumer.

Decide admission for the originating visit and attempt before starting decode. Retirement must reject subsequent packets even when physical cleanup is not yet available. README.md: "One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit
more than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide
another visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the
returned cleanup handle." Check hide, switch and same-file reopening within that startup window.

Separate admission, audit and visible publication. Preserve audit when an admitted decode settles after navigation, while checking originating visit identity again before painting. README.md: "recordProgress appends transfer history; showProgress paints the open panel." src/Workflow.java: "Consumer<Object> deliver=frame->{ audit.accept(frame);view.accept(frame,order);};" and "boolean current(Visit v){return visit==v;}" Listener removal alone cannot revoke an already-started decode's completion.

Assign arrival identity before decoding and prevent a completion older than the displayed frame from replacing it; retain audit independently of display freshness. TASK: "Full\nprogress frames may decode out of order; do not allow an older frame to roll the\ncurrent display backward." Do not infer freshness from loaded bytes: README.md states "A full frame replaces displayed state; loaded values can decrease or reset."

Establish cleanup ownership before synchronous progress can navigate, retire a visit before invoking reentrant cleanup, and prevent an outer startup from overwriting a newer visit's resources. Preserve idempotent removal and cancellation. README.md: "Removing a listener commits removal before calling the host detach callback;\nthat callback may synchronously select, hide or dispose. Repeated removal is\ninert." Verify navigation both during startup and during listener removal.

Preserve accepted retry commands and their entry-bound records across cancellation callbacks; do not add an early-return policy merely because cancellation navigated. TASK requires preserving "transfer, retry, navigation, cleanup, audit, or queue-record behavior." Original src/Workflow.java captures the visit before cancellation and then enqueues: "v.handle.cancel(); Visit accepted=v;Attempt h=enqueue(accepted,\"retry\");" Its record captures "Map<String,Object> entry=obj(\"fileId\",v.file.id,\"attemptId\",n,\"visitId\",v.id,\"kind\",kind);" Check both command preservation and protection of the newly current visit.

Exclude unrelated record and diagnostic-policy changes. README.md: "Queue records are {fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}
unless a separate authorization adds byteCount from file.size." It also states "The same source service also has a diagnostic consumer, Telemetry/
collectProgressTelemetry, whose existing live delta observations are separate
from the panel. Keep its existing behavior during this maintenance." A panel-specific repair does not authorize changing every consumer of the shared source.

Verify warm startup plus later streaming, reverse decode completion with retained audit, valid decreasing/reset frames, delayed completion after retirement, and reopening the same source. Independently exercise synchronous hide, switch and dispose during startup or cleanup, including subsequent packets before startup returns. TASK: "Preserve ordinary streaming, diagnostic telemetry,\nand subsequent uses." Assert queue shape, notices, retry and cancellation alongside display behavior; successful display checks alone do not establish preservation.

limitations: These rules derive from TASK and the supplied original public sources. Experience, automatic contracts, candidate patches and evaluation observations are not normative evidence.
No implementation was modified or executed. Passing examples do not establish causality, exhaustive correctness or benefit on other tasks.
The supplied syntax analysis reports src/Workflow.java as unsupported; it proves no control-flow, aliasing or lifecycle properties.

README.md limits the model: "A decode result resolves once; rejected decode and physical transfer completion\nare outside this embedding's model. Each workspace has its own lifetime." Broader concurrency and failure behavior remain unspecified.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
